registration.title: Registration
registration.content:
For the Service, registration is completed when an applicant agrees to these Terms and sends a message to the inquiry forum of the Make It A Quote Support Discord server.

If Neody determines that an applicant for registration falls under any of the following, Neody may delete or block the registration, and shall not be obligated to disclose any reason for doing so.

  • The application is from a person who has previously violated these Terms
  • Any other case in which Neody determines that registration is not appropriate
